COURT TRIAL - BOTH PARTIES ARE PRESENT. THE DEFENDANT WAIVES TRIAL. THE COURT AWARDS JUDGMENT TO PLAINTIFF AS FOLLOWS: $1,000.00 DAMAGES PLUS $115.00 COSTS; POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES AT 1060 FOLSOM ST., ROOM 3, SAN FRANCISCO, AND FORFEITURE OF THE LEASE, FORTHWITH.
